name: Verify assistant handles input with typos and grammatical errors
objective: Validate that the assistant can identify intent even when the user's input contains typos and grammatical errors.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Type a message with typos and grammatical errors
steps.testData: "my compter is not wrking and i cant acess email"
steps.expectedResult: Message is submitted to the assistant

steps.description: Verify the assistant identifies the intent despite errors
steps.expectedResult: The assistant identifies this as a computer/email issue
The assistant provides relevant help options (knowledge article, create ticket, etc.)
